info.album: Go Now - The Songs of The Moody Blues and Wings

podcast.body: This "beat combo style single" was a Top 10 hit for The Moody Blues during the early years of the British Invasion, but its sound gave little indication of the band's future musical direction. It stands as one of their three American Top 10 hits across different decades. "In the 60s go now, in the 70s Night's in White Satin and in the 80s your wildest dreams."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
